## About
Raw Electrical Services, LLC stands for reliable, affordable and willing. We work on homes and commercial spaces from our office at 1003 Atascocita Road in Humble, serving the greater Houston area.
Along with maintenance and repairs, we offer energy-saving tips and home safety inspections. Our electricians are licensed by the state of Texas and have gone through background checks and routine drug screening, so you know who is coming into your home.
Our customers have given us a 4.9 rating across 111 Google reviews. One longtime customer said they have relied on us for years.

## Services
- Residential repairs and preventative maintenance: Electrical repairs around your home, plus maintenance to help head off problems.
- Panels and power: Work on your current panel so you can expand how much power you use.
- Installation services: Installation work for renovating your home or office.
- Generator interlock switches and outlets: Interlock switches and generator outlets so your generator can power your home.
- Car charging outlets: Outlets for charging your car at home, with a free estimate.
- Home safety inspections: A look over your home's electrical system for safety, along with tips for saving energy.
- Breaker boxes and risers: New breaker boxes and risers, and rerouting outside wires.

## FAQ
Q: Do you charge for estimates?
A: No. We offer free estimates for any electrical project.

Q: Can I call you in an emergency?
A: Yes. Emergency service is available around the clock.

Q: What area do you serve?
A: We serve both homes and businesses within 50 miles of greater Houston, from our office in Humble.
